mappings.note: Translation v1 contains text about Ephraim surrounding with lies and Judah being inconstant that does not appear in the OSMAIN text. The OSMAIN text begins its narrative at what corresponds to Translation v2.
Content matches OSMAIN v1 perfectly (Ephraim herds wind, lies, violence, Assyria, Egypt).
Content matches OSMAIN v2 perfectly (LORD has a case with Judah, punish Jacob).
Content matches OSMAIN v3 perfectly (womb, heel, manhood, fought with God).

Translation v5 covers the first half of OSMAIN v4 (fought angel, overcame, wept). However, Translation v6 contains the second half of OSMAIN v4 ('In Bethel he found us...'). The translation has split OSMAIN v4 into two verses.

Translation v6 contains the second half of OSMAIN v4 ('In Bethel he found us...') AND the content of OSMAIN v5 ('LORD God of hosts'). This is a complex split/merge. Specifically, the phrase 'A Béthel il le trouva...' belongs to OSMAIN v4's narrative flow in this translation structure, while 'L'Éternel est le Dieu des armées' matches OSMAIN v5. The mapping shows Translation v6 contains the tail of OSMAIN v4 and all of OSMAIN v5.
Content matches OSMAIN v6 perfectly (Turn to God, hold fast to kindness/justice).
Content matches OSMAIN v7 perfectly (Merchant, false weights, loves fraud).
Content matches OSMAIN v8 perfectly (Ephraim says: I am rich... no sin).
Content matches OSMAIN v9 perfectly (I am LORD your God from Egypt... tents).
Content matches OSMAIN v10 perfectly (Spoke to prophets, visions, similitudes).
Content matches OSMAIN v11 perfectly (Gilead wickedness, Gilgal oxen, altars like stones).
Content matches OSMAIN v12 perfectly (Jacob fled to Aram, served for a woman).
Content matches OSMAIN v13 perfectly (By a prophet brought up from Egypt... guarded).
Content matches OSMAIN v14 perfectly (Ephraim provoked wrath, blood guilt, disgrace).

extraContent.description: The entire verse: 'Éphraïm m'a environné de mensonge, et la maison d'Israël de tromperie; et Juda est encore inconstant avec Dieu, avec le Saint, le Fidèle.' This content is completely absent from the OSMAIN text provided.
